title: Watch List
markdown:
**What it is:** A set of external monitors that watch the outside world for you — stock tickers, RSS/Atom feeds, vendor status pages, regulatory filings, web-search queries, and changes to specific web pages.

**What it does:**

- Add a monitor, choose its type, and set a cadence, severity range, and optional trigger.
- Enable or disable a monitor without deleting it, and see when it last fired.
- Let qualifying signals flow into your briefing as proposals — the same path as inbound email or Slack.
- Edit the whole list from chat as well as here.

*Note: stock/filing/page monitors are cheap; web-search monitors cost per check, so prefer slower cadences for those.*
